_comment: YourPHR shipped defaults (#456). Flat, dotted, LOWERCASE keys; values keep their case. Do NOT edit this file to configure an instance — put only what differs in <data>/config/app-custom-config.json, which is outside git. Keys here map to env as YOURPHR_<KEY> with '.' and '-' becoming '_' (operator.contact_email -> YOURPHR_OPERATOR_CONTACT_EMAIL). Keys beginning with _ are comments and are stripped on load.
_comment_web: HTTP listener. web.listen.port is the port INSIDE the container; host.port is what docker-compose published outside it.
_comment_host: Unprefixed HOST_IP / HOST_PORT, describing how the app is reached from OUTSIDE the container. Bound explicitly because env auto-mapping only covers YOURPHR_*.
_comment_relay: SMART on FHIR OAuth relay. relay.url is where the backend POLLS /pending (may be cluster-internal); relay.public_url is the origin the PROVIDER redirects the browser to. Empty values fall back to the project relay.
_comment_metrics: Process metrics scrape server for completed sync jobs. Internal only.
_comment_storage: storage.data_dir names the directory holding everything this instance owns and must not lose: db, cache, backups, the generated JWT key, and this config's custom overlay. Empty means derive it from database.location's parent. It NEVER moves the database — see #451.
_comment_database: database.location is an absolute path inside the container. Setting it is independent of storage.data_dir.
_comment_backup: Scheduled backup of the database. All empty/false/0 by default: the Admin Dashboard Database card persists the operator's real choices to .backup_settings.json, and these only seed a first run. backup.allowed-roots confines where a destination may point.
_comment_jwt: jwt.issuer.key is the HS256 key signing every session — the root of trust for auth and per-user isolation. It is an ENV REFERENCE, not a value (#460): set YOURPHR_JWT_ISSUER_KEY and it is used; leave it unset and the value resolves empty, which the code reads as 'nobody set a key' and generates a random 256-bit one, persisting it to <data>/.jwt_issuer_key. So a stock install is secure with no action. Do NOT put a literal key here — this file is in git.
_comment_cda: C-CDA / CCD import needs the external fhir-converter sidecar, so it is opt-in.
_comment_medications: Patient-friendly medication names from the embedded (offline) RxTerms crosswalk. The API fallback makes outbound calls to RxNav, so it is off by default.
_comment_sync: Background refresh of provider access tokens. Set to 0 or less to disable the worker.
_comment_theme: UI theme id, served unauthenticated so it can apply before first paint. Empty means the frontend's built-in default.
_comment_public: Keys served by GET /api/instance/public to callers with NO login (#457). Direction matters: this is an allow-list, so a key added anywhere else in this file is private until it is named here. A deny-list would publish anything nobody remembered to list. An instance may change this array in <data>/config/app-custom-config.json — including adding keys — and the server logs a WARN naming anything promoted beyond this shipped set. NOTE operator.contact_email is deliberately absent (#459): an address on an unauthenticated endpoint gets harvested. Signed-in users still see it via GET /api/secure/instance, and an operator running a public help desk can add it back here.
_comment_operator: Who runs this instance. Shown on /contact. Set from Admin Dashboard -> Instance; the operator is the data controller for the records held here.
